script.title: The Pelican Pedal Express
script.description: A white pelican rides a turquoise bicycle: one black-tipped wing balances, the other steers, and oversized webbed feet work opposite pedals. A blue courier scarf streams behind its long golden bill and deep orange throat pouch.
